title: bl_authority.strict_signals blanks a run of bare words in the question and every option whenever the question holds which words or what words, so a spend ask worded as a word list loses its money signal
goal: bl_authority.strict_signals blanks a quoted word list only in a gate whose question names a pattern, regex or cue, so a gate that asks the agent to spend or pay in a comma list keeps its money signal

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_authority as a;s=a.strict_signals({"question":"Which words may the agent say before we spend, pay, bill the account?","options":["yes","no"]});print(s);sys.exit(0 if any(k=="money" for k,_ in s) else 1)
